answer: Each agent earns voting weight only after completing a sequence of randomly assigned tasks whose answers are checked against independently sampled peers, with rewards locked until the checks pass. A Sybil operator must fund many separate accounts and keep them coordinated across unpredictable tasks; one shared model may give correlated answers that expose the cluster, while distinct reliable agents multiply labor and capital costs. The nadir of trust is a nebula of new identities, but ivory credentials alone grant no influence.
